model.name: convaiinnovations/laya-multilingual
model.used_for: coordinator intake: classifies each complaint and flags prompt injection before evidence is fetched; recorded on the first task_assigned trace event
model.note: Decisions, refunds and evidence are computed from MCP evidence and the MCP policy by deterministic rules; the model does not change any output field.

run.command: day09 run && day09 validate && day09 package --output dist/submission.zip
run.mcp_retry_policy: timeouts retried at most 2 times; tool errors never retried
